cohort: Women aged 15-49 years in the Philippines who had given birth within two years prior to the 2017 Philippine National Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Women from certain regions, who listened to the radio, and who had a cesarean section were less likely to practice early breastfeeding initiation, while women who read newspapers/magazines and had infants at a later birth order were more likely.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth through cesarean section were less likely to practice early breastfeeding initiation.
